Technology ranks third on genuine fundamental support from NVIDIA's capex-driven guidance, but its recent move is continuation rather than overreaction, so the remaining slot stays in SPY. Rate-sensitive defensives, solar, Brazil and aerospace show deteriorating rather than temporary weakness, and crypto's recent surge lacks independent in-window support.
